description: Looking for a portable military style travel bag? Look no further! Our Heavyweight Classic Canvas Passport Travel Pouch offers an all-in-one place to organize and carry your small travel essentials. This compact crossbody bag features an easy-to-reach identification window underneath the front flap. This utility bag measures 9 inch x 7 inch x 4 inch overall, and keeps your possessions close to you through a crossbody design. It’s also great for travel, work, everyday use, and more. Durable Material Construction: Consisting of 22 oz. heavyweight, double-stitched cotton canvas material, these passport pouches are built tough and will withstand consistent use. The brass zippers provide additional strength while emulating a time-less look and feel. Safe and Secure: Designed to keep your travel gear organized, the rear zipper utility compartment contains 2 open top pockets for a passport or pamphlet sized documents, 4 pen holders, a hook & loop closure pocket for small or loose items, and a d-ring for carabiners and other fasteners. Spacious Storage Compartments: The neck wallet’s main zipper compartment is perfect for storing bulkier items like a camera or water bottle. Along with 2 external pen holders, the crossbody travel bag features a side zipper compartment that’s idea for notepads, maps, and other paperwork. Keep your phone, wallet, and keys secure underneath the open top buckle closure, and earbuds or loose change inside the front flap’s zipper pocket. Various Carrying Options: These heavy-duty canvas bags come equipped with an adjustable shoulder strap that extends up to 56 inches, giving you the option to wear as a crossbody bag, or either around your neck or shoulder. The straps can be removed by detaching the 2 side clips, allowing you to easily store it in your car or larger bag. There’s also a belt loop sewn on the back for additional mobility. Top Grade Canvas: Made from Rothco’s rugged, durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of premium canvas bags and packs.
